caseName: Texas v. Certain Named & Unnamed Undocumented Alien Children
caseNameFull: Texas v. Certain Named and Unnamed Undocumented Alien Children

opinions.text: Appeal from C. A. 5th Cir. Motion of appellant Texas to expedite consideration of the appeal granted. Motion of appellees Sandra and Maria Cardenas for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Probable jurisdiction noted, case consolidated with No. 80-1538, Plyer, Superintendent, Tyler Independent School District, et al. v. Doe, Guardian, et al. [probable jurisdiction noted, 451 U. S. 968], and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.
